why_this_matters: WP804 safely preserves ABSTAIN under public goal ambiguity, Hyperposition safely preserves alternatives, and EAS safely ranks discriminator candidates; however the current path has no typed causal derivation for expected_information_gain_micros. Without that bridge, information-seeking action scores are caller claims rather than reproducible consequences of exact state/model/policy identity.

steps: create immutable typed score-derivation input/receipt structures
derive normalized information gain deterministically from exact outcome partitions for the explicit uniform-compatible-set policy
fail closed on missing/extra alternatives, stale state/model/policy digests, missing policy identity and unbound legal probes
construct existing DiscriminatorCandidate only from a verified score receipt
feed unchanged Epistemic Action Selection and preserve proposal-only authority
add matched case A/case B probe-switch regression from Trigger6 E4
add permutation-invariance and state/model/policy mutation regressions
measure component CPU time, wall latency and allocation/RSS delta against existing direct hand-scored candidate construction

positive: same bound state/model/policy yields identical receipt and score digest
case A uniquely selects probe-color and case B uniquely selects probe-shape from derived scores under equal budget
existing EAS remains unchanged or changes only if a separately justified ABI requirement is discovered
no provider/model call on deterministic synthetic path
negative: missing Bayesian prior fails in Bayesian mode
non-EIG criterion cannot masquerade as expected_information_gain_micros
arbitrary caller hand-score cannot obtain verified score-receipt status
acceptance_logic.performance: record p50/p95 wall time over a bounded deterministic microbenchmark and peak allocation/RSS where available; no performance promotion from expectation alone

counterhypotheses: The bridge adds complexity without improving any real decision because no legal probe-outcome model exists at the actual WP804 boundary.
A version-space/minimax criterion is more appropriate than Shannon EIG for uncalibrated alternatives; if so, bind a truthful policy/ABI rather than encoding the score under false EIG semantics.
The scoring path is not on the critical runtime frontier and should remain research-only until a consumer path exists.
forbidden_promotions: synthetic outcome model -> world model truth
